summary: Off-registry dependency sourced from mutable GitHub branch tarball
details: package.json declares its only dependency, `node-acct-utilssss21`, as a direct tarball URL on a personal GitHub account's mutable main branch (`https://github.com/GamerD11/ping_test/raw/refs/heads/main/node-acct-utils-1.0.0.tgz`) rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches that tarball and installs whatever it currently contains, running any lifecycle scripts bundled inside, with no version pin and no integrity check. The owner of that repository can change the delivered bytes at any time without any change to this package. The dependency name does not correspond to an established package and resembles a squat-style identifier, and the shipped package body is otherwise a stub, so the manifest line is the entire payload surface. The dependency source is unrelated to any declared repository or publisher for this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
